title.sk: Carnitas tacos – trhané bravčové s pomarančom
title.en: Carnitas tacos: pulled pork with orange

description.sk: Bravčové pliecko pomaly pečené s pomarančom a rascou, na konci opečené dochrumkava.
description.en: Pork shoulder slow-roasted with orange and cumin, then crisped at the end.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 160 °C. Mäso nakrájaj na kusy asi 6 cm a v pekáči ho premiešaj so soľou, rascou, oreganom, čili a prelisovaným cesnakom.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 160 °C. Cut the pork into roughly 6 cm chunks and toss in a roasting tin with the salt, cumin, oregano, chilli and crushed garlic.

steps.sk: Pridaj cibuľu nakrájanú na štvrtiny, šťavu z pomarančov a jednej limetky a vytlačené šupky pomarančov. Prikry alobalom a peč 2 a pol hodiny, kým sa mäso nerozpadá pod vidličkou.
steps.en: Add the onion cut into quarters, the juice of the oranges and one lime and the squeezed orange halves. Cover with foil and roast for 2½ hours until the meat falls apart under a fork.

steps.sk: Mäso vyber, vidličkami natrhaj a vráť do pekáča k šťave, šupky a cibuľu vyhoď. Zvýš teplotu na 230 °C a peč odkryté 15 až 20 minút, kým okraje mäsa nie sú chrumkavé.
steps.en: Lift out the pork, shred it with two forks and return it to the juices, discarding the orange halves and onion. Raise the oven to 230 °C and roast uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes until the edges are crisp.

steps.sk: Červenú cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a premiešaj so šťavou zo zvyšnej limetky. Tortilly zohrej na suchej panvici.
steps.en: Finely chop the red onion and toss with the juice of the remaining lime. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.

steps.sk: Do tortíl daj mäso, cibuľu a koriander. Carnitas vydržia v chladničke 4 dni a dajú sa zamraziť – pred podávaním ich opeč na panvici, aby boli znova chrumkavé.
steps.en: Fill the tortillas with the pork, onion and coriander. The carnitas keep in the fridge for 4 days and freeze well; fry them in a pan before serving to crisp them up again.

title.sk: Tacos al pastor s ananásom
title.en: Tacos al pastor with pineapple

description.sk: Bravčové marinované v paprike, čili a ananásovej šťave, opečené s ananásom.
description.en: Pork marinated in paprika, chilli and pineapple juice, seared with pineapple.

steps.sk: Tretinu ananásu rozmixuj s paprikou, čili, rascou, oreganom, cesnakom, octom a soľou na marinádu. Mäso nakrájaj na tenké plátky asi 5 mm, obaľ v marináde a nechaj aspoň 2 hodiny v chladničke.
steps.en: Blend a third of the pineapple with the paprika, chilli, cumin, oregano, garlic, vinegar and salt into a marinade. Slice the pork thinly, about 5 mm, coat in the marinade and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

steps.sk: Zvyšný ananás nakrájaj na kocky a cibuľu nadrobno. Na rozpálenej panvici opeč ananás nasucho 4 minúty, kým sa okraje nezačnú karamelizovať, a vyber ho.
steps.en: Dice the remaining pineapple and finely chop the onion. Sear the pineapple in a hot dry pan for 4 minutes until caramelised at the edges, then lift it out.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozpáľ olej na vysokom ohni a mäso opekaj po častiach 3 až 4 minúty, kým nie je opečené s chrumkavými okrajmi a vo vnútri prepečené. Nakrájaj ho na drobné kúsky.
steps.en: Heat the oil in the pan over a high heat and fry the pork in batches for 3 to 4 minutes until browned with crisp edges and cooked through. Chop it into small pieces.

steps.sk: Tortilly zohrej a naplň mäsom, ananásom, cibuľou a koriandrom. Podávaj s mesiačikmi limetky.
steps.en: Warm the tortillas and fill with the pork, pineapple, onion and coriander. Serve with lime wedges.

title.sk: Zeleninové enchiladas so zelenou omáčkou
title.en: Vegetable enchiladas with green sauce

description.sk: Tortilly plnené čiernou fazuľou, kukuricou a cuketou, zapečené v zelenej omáčke so syrom.
description.en: Tortillas filled with black beans, corn and courgette, baked in a green sauce with cheese.

steps.sk: Zelené papriky, polovicu cibule a čili upeč pod grilom 10 minút, kým šupka nie je miestami čierna, potom ich rozmixuj s koriandrom, cesnakom, šťavou z limetky, soľou a 150 ml vody na zelenú omáčku.
steps.en: Grill the green peppers, half the onion and the chilli for 10 minutes until charred, then blend with the coriander, garlic, lime juice, salt and 150 ml of water into a green sauce.

steps.sk: Zvyšnú cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a cuketu na drobné kocky a opeč ich na oleji 5 minút. Pridaj fazuľu, kukuricu a rascu a fazuľu zľahka roztlač. Plnku nesoľ, fazuľa aj syr sú dosť slané.
steps.en: Finely chop the remaining onion, dice the courgette small and fry them in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the beans, corn and cumin and lightly crush the beans. Do not salt the filling; the beans and cheese are salty enough.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Na dno misy nalej tretinu omáčky. Každú tortillu naplň plnkou a trochou syra, zroluj a polož do misy švom nadol.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Pour a third of the sauce into a baking dish. Fill each tortilla with filling and a little cheese, roll up and lay seam side down in the dish.

steps.sk: Polej zvyšnou omáčkou, posyp syrom a peč 20 minút, kým syr nebublá a okraje tortíl nie sú chrumkavé. Podávaj s kyslou smotanou. V chladničke vydržia 3 dni.
steps.en: Pour over the remaining sauce, sprinkle with cheese and bake for 20 minutes until the cheese bubbles and the tortilla edges are crisp. Serve with sour cream. They keep in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Kura v rýchlej omáčke mole
title.en: Chicken in a quick mole sauce

description.sk: Kuracie stehná v hustej mexickej omáčke z paradajok, čili, kakaa, arašidov a škorice.
description.en: Chicken thighs in a thick Mexican sauce of tomato, chilli, cocoa, peanuts and cinnamon.

steps.sk: Stehná opeč na oleji v hrnci z oboch strán 3 minúty dozlatista a vyber ich. Na výpekoch opekaj nakrájanú cibuľu 5 minút, pridaj cesnak, čili, papriku, rascu a škoricu a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Brown the chicken in the oil in a pot for 3 minutes per side and lift it out. Fry the chopped onion in the juices for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, chilli, paprika, cumin and cinnamon and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, kakao, arašidové maslo, hrozienka a 300 ml vody s bujónom a var 10 minút. Potom omáčku rozmixuj dohladka a vmiešaj čokoládu, kým sa nerozpustí.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, cocoa, peanut butter, raisins and 300 ml of water with the stock cube and simmer for 10 minutes. Then blend the sauce until smooth and stir in the chocolate until melted.

steps.sk: Vráť mäso do omáčky a var pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 30 minút, kým mäso nie je mäkké. Omáčka má byť hustá a lesklá, tmavohnedá – nie sladká, ale hlboká a pikantná.
steps.en: Return the chicken to the sauce and simmer, covered, over a low heat for 30 minutes until tender. The sauce should be thick, glossy and dark brown: not sweet, but deep and spicy.

steps.sk: Sezam opraž na suchej panvici. Kura podávaj s ryžou, posypané sezamom. Mole na druhý deň chutí ešte lepšie.
steps.en: Toast the sesame in a dry pan. Serve the chicken with rice, sprinkled with sesame. Mole tastes even better the next day.

title.sk: Chiles rellenos – papriky plnené syrom
title.en: Chiles rellenos: cheese-stuffed peppers

description.sk: Pečené papriky plnené syrom, obalené v nadýchanom vaječnom cestíčku, v paradajkovej omáčke.
description.en: Roasted peppers stuffed with cheese, coated in a fluffy egg batter, in tomato sauce.

note.sk: toľko vsiakne; na vyprážanie priprav asi 300 ml
note.en: this much is absorbed; have about 300 ml for frying

steps.sk: Papriky upeč pod grilom 10 až 12 minút, obracaj ich, kým šupka nie je čierna zo všetkých strán. Daj ich do misky, prikry a nechaj 10 minút zapariť, potom ich opatrne ošúp.
steps.en: Grill the peppers for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until the skins are black all over. Put them in a bowl, cover and leave to steam for 10 minutes, then peel carefully.

steps.sk: Na boku každej papriky urob pozdĺžny rez a vyber semienka, stopku nechaj. Naplň ju nastrúhaným cheddarom a kúskami mozzarelly a rez zopni špáradlom.
steps.en: Make a lengthways slit in the side of each pepper and remove the seeds, leaving the stalk on. Stuff with grated cheddar and pieces of mozzarella and close the slit with a cocktail stick.

steps.sk: Na omáčku opeč nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu a cesnak na lyžici oleja, pridaj passatu, čili a soľ a var 10 minút.
steps.en: For the sauce fry the finely chopped onion and garlic in a spoonful of oil, add the passata, chilli and salt and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Bielky vyšľahaj do tuha a zľahka vmiešaj žĺtky. Papriky obaľ v múke a ponor do vaječnej peny. V hlbšej panvici rozpáľ olej na 175 °C a papriky vyprážaj 2 minúty z každej strany do zlatista.
steps.en: Whisk the egg whites until stiff and gently fold in the yolks. Dust the peppers in flour and dip them in the egg foam. Heat the oil in a deep pan to 175 °C and fry the peppers for 2 minutes per side until golden.

steps.sk: Nechaj ich odkvapkať, odstráň špáradlá a podávaj v teplej paradajkovej omáčke s ryžou.
steps.en: Drain, remove the cocktail sticks and serve in the warm tomato sauce with rice.

title.sk: Tostadas s fazuľou a kuracím
title.en: Tostadas with beans and chicken

description.sk: Chrumkavé zapečené tortilly s fazuľovou nátierkou, kuracím mäsom, šalátom a salsou.
description.en: Crisp baked tortillas topped with refried beans, chicken, lettuce and salsa.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Tortilly potri tenko olejom, ulož na dva plechy a peč 8 až 10 minút, kým nie sú zlatisté a chrumkavé ako čipsy.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Brush the tortillas thinly with oil, lay them on two trays and bake for 8 to 10 minutes until golden and crisp like crisps.

steps.sk: Kuracie prsia posyp rascou, paprikou a soľou a opeč na oleji 5 až 6 minút z každej strany, kým nie sú prepečené. Nechaj ich 5 minút odpočívať a natrhaj na prúžky.
steps.en: Season the chicken with the cumin, paprika and salt and fry in oil for 5 to 6 minutes per side until cooked through. Rest for 5 minutes and shred.

steps.sk: Fazuľu zohrej s 2 lyžicami vody a roztlač na hustú nátierku. Paradajky a cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a zmiešaj s limetkovou šťavou na salsu. Šalát nakrájaj na tenké prúžky.
steps.en: Warm the beans with 2 tablespoons of water and mash into a thick spread. Finely chop the tomatoes and onion and mix with the lime juice for a salsa. Shred the lettuce.

steps.sk: Tostadas natri fazuľou, navrch daj kuracie, šalát, salsu, lyžicu kyslej smotany a rozdrobený syr. Jedz hneď rukami, kým chrumkajú.
steps.en: Spread the tostadas with the beans and top with the chicken, lettuce, salsa, a spoonful of sour cream and the crumbled cheese. Eat straight away with your hands while crisp.

title.sk: Frijoles charros – kovbojská fazuľa
title.en: Frijoles charros: cowboy beans

description.sk: Pikantná mexická fazuľa so slaninou, chorizom, paradajkami a koriandrom.
description.en: Spicy Mexican beans with bacon, chorizo, tomatoes and coriander.

steps.sk: Slaninu a chorizo nakrájaj na drobné kocky a opekaj ich v hrnci na strednom ohni 6 minút, kým nepustia tuk a nie sú chrumkavé.
steps.en: Dice the bacon and chorizo small and fry in a pot over a medium heat for 6 minutes until they release their fat and turn crisp.

steps.sk: Pridaj nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu, cesnak a čili a opekaj 5 minút. Pridaj nakrájané paradajky, rascu a oregano a var 3 minúty.
steps.en: Add the finely chopped onion, garlic and chilli and fry for 5 minutes. Add the chopped tomatoes, cumin and oregano and cook for 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj fazuľu a 400 ml vody a var na miernom ohni 20 minút, kým sa chute nespoja a šťava mierne nezhustne. Soľ netreba, slanina a chorizo stačia.
steps.en: Add the beans and 400 ml of water and simmer gently for 20 minutes until the flavours meld and the broth thickens slightly. No salt is needed; the bacon and chorizo are enough.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj nasekaný koriander a podávaj v miskách s teplými tortillami. Fazuľa vydrží v chladničke 4 dni.
steps.en: Stir in the chopped coriander and serve in bowls with warm tortillas. The beans keep in the fridge for 4 days.

title.sk: Sopa de fideo – mexická rezancová polievka
title.en: Sopa de fideo: Mexican noodle soup

description.sk: Lacná domáca polievka z opečených tenkých rezancov v paradajkovom vývare.
description.en: A cheap homestyle soup of toasted thin noodles in a tomato broth.

steps.sk: Paradajky, cibuľu a cesnak rozmixuj so 200 ml vody na hladké pyré.
steps.en: Blend the tomatoes, onion and garlic with 200 ml of water into a smooth purée.

steps.sk: V hrnci zohrej olej a nalámané špagety opekaj na strednom ohni 3 až 4 minúty za stáleho miešania, kým nie sú zlatohnedé – dodá to polievke orieškovú chuť.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a pot and fry the broken spaghetti over a medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring constantly, until golden brown; this gives the soup a nutty taste.

steps.sk: Vlej paradajkové pyré a minútu ho opekaj – zasyčí. Pridaj 1 liter vody s bujónom a rascou a var 8 minút, kým rezance nie sú mäkké.
steps.en: Pour in the tomato purée and fry for a minute; it will sizzle. Add 1 litre of water with the stock cube and the cumin and simmer for 8 minutes until the noodles are soft.

steps.sk: Podávaj s kockami avokáda, koriandrom a mesiačikmi limetky. Polievka chutí najlepšie hneď, lebo rezance postupne napučia.
steps.en: Serve with diced avocado, coriander and lime wedges. The soup is best straight away, as the noodles swell as it stands.

title.sk: Camarones a la diabla – pikantné krevety
title.en: Camarones a la diabla: devilled prawns

description.sk: Krevety v ohnivo pikantnej paradajkovo-čili omáčke s cesnakom, s ryžou.
description.en: Prawns in a fiery tomato and chilli sauce with garlic, served with rice.

steps.sk: Paradajky rozmixuj s polovicou cibule, 2 strúčikmi cesnaku, čili, údenou paprikou, čili omáčkou a soľou na hladkú omáčku. Ryžu daj variť.
steps.en: Blend the tomatoes with half the onion, 2 garlic cloves, the chilli, smoked paprika, chilli sauce and salt into a smooth sauce. Put the rice on to cook.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozpusti maslo s olejom a zvyšnú nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu a cesnak opekaj 4 minúty. Vlej omáčku a var 8 minút, kým nezhustne.
steps.en: Melt the butter with the oil in a pan and fry the rest of the onion and garlic, finely chopped, for 4 minutes. Pour in the sauce and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.

steps.sk: Pridaj krevety a var 3 až 4 minúty, kým nie sú ružové a stočené do tvaru C. Dlhšie ich nevar, stvrdnú.
steps.en: Add the prawns and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes until pink and curled into a C. Do not cook them longer or they toughen.

steps.sk: Pokvapkaj limetkou, posyp koriandrom a podávaj s ryžou. Pre menej pálivú verziu použi polovicu čili.
steps.en: Squeeze over the lime, sprinkle with coriander and serve with rice. For a milder version use half the chilli.

title.sk: Calabacitas – cuketa s kukuricou a paradajkami
title.en: Calabacitas: courgette with corn and tomatoes

description.sk: Mexická vegánska zeleninová panvica z cukety, kukurice, paradajok a čili.
description.en: A Mexican vegan vegetable sauté of courgette, corn, tomatoes and chilli.

steps.sk: Cuketu nakrájaj na kocky asi 1,5 cm, cibuľu a paradajky nadrobno, cesnak a čili nasekaj.
steps.en: Dice the courgettes into roughly 1.5 cm cubes, finely chop the onion and tomatoes and chop the garlic and chilli.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici zohrej olej a cibuľu opekaj 4 minúty. Pridaj cesnak, čili, rascu a oregano a 30 sekúnd opekaj.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 4 minutes. Add the garlic, chilli, cumin and oregano and fry for 30 seconds.

steps.sk: Pridaj cuketu a opekaj na vysokom ohni 5 minút, kým nezačne zlatnúť. Pridaj kukuricu, paradajky a soľ a var 5 minút, kým paradajky nepustia šťavu a cuketa nie je mäkká, ale drží tvar.
steps.en: Add the courgettes and fry over a high heat for 5 minutes until starting to colour. Add the corn, tomatoes and salt and cook for 5 minutes until the tomatoes release their juice and the courgette is tender but holding its shape.

steps.sk: Dochuť limetkou a podávaj s teplými tortillami alebo ako prílohu. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Season with lime and serve with warm tortillas or as a side. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Flautas – chrumkavé rolky s kuracím
title.en: Flautas: crisp chicken rolls

description.sk: Pevne zrolované tortilly plnené trhaným kuracím mäsom, upečené dochrumkava.
description.en: Tightly rolled tortillas filled with shredded chicken, baked until crisp.

steps.sk: Kuracie prsia uvar v osolenej vode 15 minút, kým nie sú prepečené, a natrhaj ich vidličkami. Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a opeč s cesnakom na lyžici oleja 5 minút.
steps.en: Simmer the chicken in salted water for 15 minutes until cooked through and shred with two forks. Finely chop the onion and fry with the garlic in a spoonful of oil for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso, passatu, rascu, čili a soľ a var 5 minút, kým sa tekutina takmer neodparí – plnka musí byť suchá, inak by tortilly zmäkli.
steps.en: Add the chicken, passata, cumin, chilli and salt and cook for 5 minutes until the liquid has almost evaporated; the filling must be dry or the tortillas go soft.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C. Tortilly zohrej, aby boli ohybné. Na spodný okraj každej daj pás plnky a syra a pevne ich zroluj ako cigaru. Ulož ich na plech švom nadol a potri olejom.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Warm the tortillas so they are pliable. Put a line of filling and cheese along the bottom edge of each and roll up tightly like a cigar. Lay seam side down on a tray and brush with oil.

steps.sk: Peč 15 minút, kým nie sú zlatohnedé a chrumkavé. Podávaj s prúžkami šalátu, kyslou smotanou a roztlačeným avokádom.
steps.en: Bake for 15 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Serve with shredded lettuce, sour cream and mashed avocado.

title.sk: Birria tacos s vývarom na namáčanie
title.en: Birria tacos with dipping broth

description.sk: Hovädzie dusené v korenistej čili omáčke, opečené v tortillách so syrom a podávané s vývarom.
description.en: Beef braised in a spiced chilli sauce, crisped in tortillas with cheese and served with the broth.

steps.sk: Paradajky, polovicu cibule, cesnak, čili, papriku, rascu, oregano a ocot rozmixuj na hustú omáčku. Mäso nakrájaj na veľké kusy a osoľ.
steps.en: Blend the tomatoes, half the onion, the garlic, chilli, paprika, cumin, oregano and vinegar into a thick sauce. Cut the beef into large chunks and season with salt.

steps.sk: Mäso daj do hrnca, zalej omáčkou a 1 litrom vody, pridaj škoricu a bobkové listy. Priveď do varu, prikry a dus na miernom ohni 3 hodiny, kým sa mäso nerozpadá.
steps.en: Put the beef in a pot, cover with the sauce and 1 litre of water and add the cinnamon and bay leaves. Bring to the boil, cover and braise over a low heat for 3 hours until the meat falls apart.

steps.sk: Mäso vyber a natrhaj. Z vývaru zober tuk z povrchu do misky – budeš ho potrebovať na opekanie tortíl. Vývar dochuť soľou a udržuj horúci.
steps.en: Lift out the beef and shred it. Skim the fat from the top of the broth into a bowl; you will use it to fry the tortillas. Season the broth with salt and keep it hot.

steps.sk: Tortillu namoč z jednej strany do tuku z vývaru a polož na rozpálenú panvicu. Na polovicu daj syr a mäso, preklop a opekaj 2 minúty z každej strany do chrumkava.
steps.en: Dip one side of a tortilla in the broth fat and lay it in a hot pan. Put cheese and beef on one half, fold over and fry for 2 minutes per side until crisp.

steps.sk: Podávaj s miskou horúceho vývaru na namáčanie, posypaným nasekanou cibuľou a koriandrom, s limetkou.
steps.en: Serve with a cup of hot broth for dipping, sprinkled with chopped onion and coriander, with lime.

title.sk: Tacos s pečeným batátom a čiernou fazuľou
title.en: Roasted sweet potato and black bean tacos

description.sk: Vegánske tacos s korenistým batátom, fazuľou, avokádom a limetkovou kapustou.
description.en: Vegan tacos with spiced sweet potato, black beans, avocado and lime slaw.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 210 °C. Batáty ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky asi 1,5 cm, premiešaj s olejom, paprikou, rascou, čili a polovicou soli a rozlož na plech. Peč 25 minút, v polovici obráť, kým nie sú mäkké a opečené.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Peel the sweet potatoes, cut into roughly 1.5 cm cubes, toss with the oil, paprika, cumin, chilli and half the salt and spread on a tray. Roast for 25 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned.

steps.sk: Kapustu nakrájaj na tenké rezance a premiešaj so šťavou z jednej limetky a štipkou soli – zmäkne a bude chrumkavá. Fazuľu zohrej so zvyšnou soľou a lyžicou vody.
steps.en: Shred the cabbage finely and toss with the juice of one lime and a pinch of salt; it softens yet stays crunchy. Warm the beans with the remaining salt and a spoonful of water.

steps.sk: Avokádo roztlač so šťavou zo zvyšnej limetky. Tortilly zohrej na suchej panvici.
steps.en: Mash the avocado with the juice of the remaining lime. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.

steps.sk: Tortilly natri avokádom, navrch daj fazuľu, batáty a kapustu a posyp koriandrom. Plnku bez avokáda môžeš pripraviť na 3 dni dopredu.
steps.en: Spread the tortillas with avocado and top with the beans, sweet potato and slaw, then scatter with coriander. The filling, without the avocado, can be made 3 days ahead.

title.sk: Arroz verde – zelená ryža s koriandrom
title.en: Arroz verde: green rice with coriander

description.sk: Mexická ryža uvarená v rozmixovanom koriandri, špenáte a zelenej paprike, vegánska.
description.en: Mexican rice cooked in blended coriander, spinach and green pepper, vegan.

steps.sk: Koriander, špenát, papriku, cibuľu a cesnak rozmixuj s 500 ml vody a bujónom na hladkú zelenú tekutinu.
steps.en: Blend the coriander, spinach, pepper, onion and garlic with 500 ml of water and the stock cube into a smooth green liquid.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni. V hrnci zohrej olej a ryžu opekaj na strednom ohni 3 minúty, kým zrnká nie sú priesvitné na okrajoch.
steps.en: Rinse the rice. Heat the oil in a pot and fry the rice over a medium heat for 3 minutes until the grains are translucent at the edges.

steps.sk: Zalej zelenou tekutinou, priveď do varu, prikry a var na minimálnom ohni 15 minút, kým ryža nevpije tekutinu. Pokrievku neodkrývaj – para ryžu dovarí.
steps.en: Pour in the green liquid, bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 15 minutes until the rice has absorbed it. Do not lift the lid; the steam finishes the rice.

steps.sk: Nechaj 10 minút odpočívať, prečechraj vidličkou a pokvapkaj limetkou. Podávaj samotnú alebo ako prílohu k tacos a fazuli.
steps.en: Rest for 10 minutes, fluff with a fork and squeeze over the lime. Serve on its own or as a side to tacos and beans.

title.sk: Ropa vieja – kubánske trhané hovädzie
title.en: Ropa vieja: Cuban shredded beef

description.sk: Hovädzie uvarené domäkka, natrhané a dusené s paprikami, paradajkami, vínom a olivami.
description.en: Beef simmered until tender, shredded and braised with peppers, tomatoes, wine and olives.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na tri veľké kusy, daj ho do hrnca, zalej vodou tak, aby bolo ponorené, a pridaj bobkové listy a polovicu soli. Priveď do varu, stiahni na mierny oheň a var pod pokrievkou 1 a pol hodiny, kým sa mäso nedá ľahko natrhať.
steps.en: Cut the beef into three large pieces, put it in a pot, cover with water and add the bay leaves and half the salt. Bring to the boil, lower the heat and simmer, covered, for 1½ hours until the meat pulls apart easily.

steps.sk: Mäso vyber, nechaj ho trochu vychladnúť a z vývaru odober 300 ml. Mäso natrhaj dvoma vidličkami pozdĺž vlákien na tenké pásiky – podľa nich dostalo jedlo meno „staré šaty“.
steps.en: Lift out the beef, let it cool a little and set aside 300 ml of the broth. Shred the meat with two forks along the grain into thin strands; they give the dish its name, 'old clothes'.

steps.sk: V širokej panvici zohrej olej a cibuľu a papriky nakrájané na tenké pásiky opekaj na strednom ohni 8 minút, kým nezmäknú. Pridaj nasekaný cesnak, rascu, oregano a paradajkový pretlak a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide pan and fry the onion and peppers, cut into thin strips, over a medium heat for 8 minutes until soft. Add the chopped garlic, cumin, oregano and tomato paste and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Podlej vínom a nechaj 2 minúty odparovať, potom pridaj paradajky, odložený vývar, zvyšnú soľ a natrhané mäso. Var bez pokrievky na miernom ohni 20 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne a mäso ju nenasaje.
steps.en: Pour in the wine and let it bubble for 2 minutes, then add the tomatoes, the reserved broth, the remaining salt and the shredded beef. Simmer uncovered over a low heat for 20 minutes until the sauce thickens and the meat soaks it up.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj olivy prekrojené na polovice a podávaj s bielou ryžou. Ropa vieja vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a dá sa zamraziť; na druhý deň je ešte chutnejšia.
steps.en: Stir in the halved olives and serve with white rice. Ropa vieja keeps in the fridge for 4 days and freezes well; it tastes even better the next day.

title.sk: Ají de gallina – peruánske kura v krémovej omáčke
title.en: Ají de gallina: Peruvian creamy chilli chicken

description.sk: Natrhané kuracie mäso v hustej omáčke z chleba, mlieka, orechov, syra a žltého čili.
description.en: Shredded chicken in a thick sauce of bread, milk, walnuts, cheese and yellow chilli.

note.sk: žlté alebo červené, namiesto ají amarillo
note.en: yellow or red, instead of ají amarillo

steps.sk: Kuracie prsia daj do hrnca so 600 ml vody a polovicou soli, priveď do varu a var na miernom ohni 15 minút, kým nie sú v strede prepečené. Vyber ich, natrhaj na tenké vlákna a vývar si odlož.
steps.en: Put the chicken in a pot with 600 ml of water and half the salt, bring to the boil and simmer gently for 15 minutes until cooked through in the centre. Lift it out, shred it into thin strands and keep the broth.

steps.sk: Chlieb natrhaj do misky, zalej mliekom a nechaj 5 minút nasiaknuť. Potom ho rozmixuj s orechmi, parmezánom a 200 ml vývaru na hustú a hladkú pastu.
steps.en: Tear the bread into a bowl, pour over the milk and leave to soak for 5 minutes. Then blend it with the walnuts, parmesan and 200 ml of the broth into a thick, smooth paste.

steps.sk: Zemiaky uvar v šupke 20 minút do mäkka, vajcia uvar natvrdo 10 minút a ryžu daj variť podľa návodu na obale. Uvarené zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na hrubé plátky.
steps.en: Boil the potatoes in their skins for 20 minutes until tender, hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes and cook the rice according to the packet. Peel the potatoes and cut them into thick slices.

steps.sk: Na oleji opekaj nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu 8 minút do zlatista, pridaj cesnak, nasekané čili, kurkumu a rascu a minútu opekaj. Vlej chlebovú pastu a za stáleho miešania var 5 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne; ak je priveľmi hustá, prilej vývar.
steps.en: Fry the finely chopped onion in the oil for 8 minutes until golden, add the garlic, chopped chilli, turmeric and cumin and fry for a minute. Pour in the bread paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes until thick; if it gets too thick, add some broth.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj natrhané mäso a zvyšnú soľ a ešte 3 minúty prehrievaj. Podávaj s ryžou a zemiakmi, ozdobené štvrtinami vajec a olivami. Bez vajec vydrží v chladničke 3 dni.
steps.en: Stir in the shredded chicken and the remaining salt and heat through for 3 more minutes. Serve with the rice and potatoes, garnished with egg quarters and olives. Without the eggs it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Pastel de choclo – čilská mäsová zapekanka pod kukuricou
title.en: Pastel de choclo: Chilean beef and corn bake

description.sk: Korenisté mleté mäso s vajcom a olivami pod krémovou kukuričnou kašou s bazalkou.
description.en: Spiced minced beef with egg and olives under a creamy corn and basil topping.

steps.sk: Kukuricu rozmixuj s mliekom a bazalkou na hrubšie pyré. V hrnci rozpusti maslo, vlej pyré, pridaj polovicu soli a za stáleho miešania var na miernom ohni 8 minút, kým nezhustne ako kaša.
steps.en: Blend the corn with the milk and basil into a coarse purée. Melt the butter in a pot, pour in the purée, add half the salt and cook over a low heat, stirring constantly, for 8 minutes until as thick as porridge.

steps.sk: Vajcia uvar natvrdo 10 minút, ošúp ich a nakrájaj na mesiačiky. Na panvici zohrej olej a nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu opekaj na strednom ohni 8 minút, kým nezmäkne a nezačne zlatnúť.
steps.en: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, peel them and cut into wedges. Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the finely chopped onion over a medium heat for 8 minutes until soft and starting to colour.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso, rascu, papriku, oregano a zvyšnú soľ a opekaj 8 minút, kým sa mäso nerozdrobí a nestratí ružovú farbu. Vmiešaj hrozienka – dodajú plnke typickú sladkastú chuť.
steps.en: Add the beef, cumin, paprika, oregano and remaining salt and fry for 8 minutes until the meat is crumbly and no longer pink. Stir in the raisins; they give the filling its typical hint of sweetness.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Mäsovú zmes rozotri do zapekacej misy, poukladaj na ňu vajcia a olivy a navrch rovnomerne natri kukuričnú kašu. Povrch posyp cukrom, v rúre sa skaramelizuje do zlatista.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Spread the meat in a baking dish, arrange the eggs and olives on top and spread the corn mixture evenly over everything. Sprinkle the surface with the sugar; it caramelises golden in the oven.

steps.sk: Peč 25 až 30 minút, kým povrch nie je zlatohnedý a po okrajoch nebublá. Pred krájaním nechaj 10 minút postáť. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni, porcie zohrievaj v rúre.
steps.en: Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until the top is golden brown and bubbling at the edges. Leave to stand for 10 minutes before cutting. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days; reheat portions in the oven.

title.sk: Ekvádorské ceviche z krevet
title.en: Ecuadorian prawn ceviche

description.sk: Uvarené krevety v osviežujúcej marináde z limetky, pomaranča a paradajok s kukuricou a avokádom.
description.en: Cooked prawns in a zesty lime, orange and tomato marinade with corn and avocado.

steps.sk: Červenú cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska, prepláchni ju studenou vodou a zalej šťavou z jednej limetky so štipkou soli. Nechaj 10 minút odstáť, zjemnie a zružovie.
steps.en: Slice the red onion into thin half-moons, rinse under cold water and pour over the juice of one lime with a pinch of salt. Leave for 10 minutes; it mellows and turns pink.

steps.sk: V hrnci priveď do varu 1 liter vody, vhoď krevety a var ich 2 až 3 minúty, kým nie sú ružové a stočené do tvaru C. Hneď ich preber do misky s ľadovou vodou, aby sa prestali variť a zostali šťavnaté.
steps.en: Bring 1 litre of water to the boil, drop in the prawns and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until pink and curled into a C. Transfer them straight into a bowl of iced water so they stop cooking and stay juicy.

steps.sk: Paradajky zbav semienok a nakrájaj na drobné kocky, čili a koriander nasekaj nadrobno. V miske zmiešaj šťavu zo zvyšných limetiek a z pomaranča s kečupom, olejom a zvyšnou soľou.
steps.en: Deseed the tomatoes and dice them small, and finely chop the chilli and coriander. In a bowl mix the juice of the remaining limes and the orange with the ketchup, oil and remaining salt.

steps.sk: Pridaj scedené krevety, paradajky, cibuľu aj s marinádou, čili, kukuricu a koriander a premiešaj. Nechaj 15 minút vychladiť v chladničke, aby sa chute spojili.
steps.en: Add the drained prawns, tomatoes, onion with its marinade, chilli, corn and coriander and stir. Chill in the fridge for 15 minutes so the flavours come together.

steps.sk: Podávaj vychladené v miskách s kockami avokáda navrchu. Ceviche zjedz v ten istý deň, krevety v kyslej marináde postupne tuhnú.
steps.en: Serve chilled in bowls topped with diced avocado. Eat the ceviche the same day, as the prawns slowly firm up in the sour marinade.

title.sk: Cazuela – čilská kuracia polievka s tekvicou a kukuricou
title.en: Cazuela: Chilean chicken soup with squash and corn

description.sk: Výdatná polievka s kusmi kuraťa, zemiakmi, tekvicou, fazuľkou, kukuricou a ryžou.
description.en: A hearty soup with chicken pieces, potatoes, squash, green beans, corn and rice.

steps.sk: Kuracie stehná daj do veľkého hrnca s 2 litrami vody a soľou, priveď do varu a naberačkou zbieraj penu, ktorá vystúpi na povrch. Var na miernom ohni 25 minút.
steps.en: Put the chicken thighs in a large pot with 2 litres of water and the salt, bring to the boil and skim off the foam that rises with a ladle. Simmer over a low heat for 25 minutes.

steps.sk: Medzitým na oleji opeč nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu, mrkvu na kolieska a nasekaný cesnak 5 minút, pridaj papriku, rascu a oregano a hneď to vsyp do polievky, aby sa paprika nepripálila.
steps.en: Meanwhile fry the finely chopped onion, the carrot cut into rounds and the chopped garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, add the paprika, cumin and oregano and tip it straight into the soup so the paprika does not burn.

steps.sk: Pridaj zemiaky prekrojené na polovice, tekvicu nakrájanú na kocky asi 4 cm a ryžu a var 15 minút.
steps.en: Add the potatoes cut in half, the squash cut into roughly 4 cm chunks and the rice and simmer for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj fazuľku nakrájanú na 3 cm a kukuricu a var ešte 8 minút, kým nie sú zemiaky mäkké a kuracie mäso sa ľahko neoddeľuje od kosti a vo vnútri nie je ružové.
steps.en: Add the green beans cut into 3 cm lengths and the corn and simmer for 8 more minutes until the potatoes are tender and the chicken comes away from the bone easily with no pink inside.

steps.sk: Do každého taniera daj kus kuraťa, zemiak a tekvicu, zalej vývarom so zeleninou a posyp nasekaným koriandrom. Polievka vydrží v chladničke 3 dni.
steps.en: Put a piece of chicken, potato and squash in each bowl, ladle over the broth with the vegetables and sprinkle with chopped coriander. The soup keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Locro – argentínsky guláš z tekvice, fazule a kukurice
title.en: Locro: Argentine squash, bean and corn stew

description.sk: Hustý zimný guláš z tekvice, bielej fazule, kukurice, bravčového a choriza s korenistým olejom.
description.en: A thick winter stew of squash, white beans, corn, pork and chorizo with a spiced oil.

steps.sk: Bravčové mäso nakrájaj na kocky 2 cm a chorizo na kolieska. V hrnci zohrej lyžicu oleja a mäso opekaj na vysokom ohni 5 minút dohneda, potom pridaj chorizo, nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu a cesnak a opekaj ďalšie 4 minúty.
steps.en: Cut the pork into 2 cm cubes and the chorizo into rounds. Heat a spoonful of oil in a pot and brown the pork over a high heat for 5 minutes, then add the chorizo, finely chopped onion and garlic and fry for 4 more minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj tekvicu nakrájanú na kocky 3 cm, kukuricu, polovicu fazule, soľ a 1,2 litra vody. Priveď do varu a var pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 50 minút, občas premiešaj, kým sa tekvica nerozvarí a guláš nezhustne.
steps.en: Add the squash cut into 3 cm cubes, the corn, half the beans, the salt and 1.2 litres of water. Bring to the boil and simmer, covered, over a low heat for 50 minutes, stirring now and then, until the squash collapses and the stew thickens.

steps.sk: Pridaj zvyšnú fazuľu a var ďalších 10 minút bez pokrievky. Locro má byť husté takmer ako kaša; ak sa začne prichytávať na dno, prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: Add the rest of the beans and simmer uncovered for another 10 minutes. Locro should be almost as thick as porridge; if it starts to catch on the bottom, add a little water.

steps.sk: Na korenistý olej zohrej na malej panvici zvyšný olej, pridaj nasekanú jarnú cibuľku, obe papriky, rascu a čili a opekaj na miernom ohni 1 minútu. Dlhšie nie, paprika sa ľahko pripáli a zhorkne.
steps.en: For the spiced oil heat the remaining oil in a small pan, add the chopped spring onions, both paprikas, the cumin and chilli and fry over a low heat for 1 minute. No longer, as paprika burns easily and turns bitter.

steps.sk: Locro naber do misiek a každú porciu pokvapkaj lyžičkou korenistého oleja. Vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a dá sa zamraziť, olej priprav vždy čerstvý.
steps.en: Ladle the locro into bowls and drizzle each portion with a teaspoon of the spiced oil. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days and freezes well; make the oil fresh each time.

title.sk: Empanadas s kukuricou a syrom (humita)
title.en: Corn and cheese empanadas (humita)

description.sk: Pečené taštičky z maslového cesta plnené krémovou kukuricou, paprikou a mozzarellou.
description.en: Baked pastries in a buttery dough filled with creamy corn, pepper and mozzarella.

note.sk: 80 g do cesta, 20 g do plnky
note.en: 80 g for the dough, 20 g for the filling

note.sk: 150 ml do cesta, 100 ml do plnky
note.en: 150 ml for the dough, 100 ml for the filling

steps.sk: Na cesto zmiešaj múku s polovicou soli, pridaj 80 g studeného masla nakrájaného na kocky a rozotri ho prstami na drobky. Prilej 150 ml teplého mlieka a vymies hladké, nelepivé cesto. Zabaľ ho do fólie a nechaj 30 minút odpočívať.
steps.en: For the dough mix the flour with half the salt, add 80 g of cold butter in cubes and rub it in with your fingertips to crumbs. Pour in 150 ml of warm milk and knead into a smooth, non-sticky dough. Wrap in film and rest for 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Cibuľu a papriku nakrájaj nadrobno a opekaj ich na 20 g masla 6 minút do mäkka. Pridaj kukuricu, mletú papriku, muškátový oriešok a zvyšnú soľ a premiešaj.
steps.en: Finely chop the onion and pepper and fry in 20 g of butter for 6 minutes until soft. Add the corn, paprika, nutmeg and remaining salt and stir.

steps.sk: Škrob rozmiešaj v 100 ml mlieka, vlej k zelenine a za stáleho miešania var 2 minúty, kým plnka nezhustne. Nechaj ju úplne vychladnúť a až potom vmiešaj mozzarellu natrhanú na kúsky, v teplej plnke by sa syr roztiekol.
steps.en: Stir the cornflour into 100 ml of milk, pour it over the vegetables and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes until the filling thickens. Let it cool completely before stirring in the mozzarella torn into pieces; in a warm filling the cheese would run.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Cesto rozvaľkaj na hrúbku 3 mm a vykrajuj kruhy s priemerom 12 cm. Na každý daj lyžicu plnky, preklop ho na polmesiac a okraje pevne stlač vidličkou, aby plnka pri pečení nevytiekla.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Roll the dough out 3 mm thick and cut out 12 cm circles. Put a spoonful of filling on each, fold into a half-moon and press the edges firmly with a fork so the filling does not leak during baking.

steps.sk: Empanadas ulož na plech s papierom na pečenie, potri rozšľahaným vajcom a peč 20 až 22 minút do zlatohneda. Nechaj ich 5 minút vychladnúť, plnka je vo vnútri horúca. Upečené sa dajú zamraziť.
steps.en: Lay the empanadas on a lined tray, brush with beaten egg and bake for 20 to 22 minutes until golden brown. Let them cool for 5 minutes, as the filling is very hot inside. Baked empanadas freeze well.

title.sk: Arroz chaufa – peruánska ryža z woku s kuracím
title.en: Arroz chaufa: Peruvian wok-fried rice with chicken

description.sk: Ryža z predošlého dňa opečená s kuracím, omeletou, zázvorom, jarnou cibuľkou a sójovou omáčkou.
description.en: Day-old rice fried with chicken, omelette, ginger, spring onions and soy sauce.

steps.sk: Ryžu uvar deň vopred alebo aspoň 3 hodiny dopredu, rozlož ju na tanier a nechaj vychladnúť v chladničke, čerstvá ryža by sa zlepila. Kuracie mäso nakrájaj na kocky 1,5 cm a premiešaj s lyžicou sójovej omáčky.
steps.en: Cook the rice the day before or at least 3 hours ahead, spread it on a plate and chill it in the fridge, as freshly cooked rice would clump. Cut the chicken into 1.5 cm cubes and toss with a spoonful of the soy sauce.

steps.sk: Vajcia rozšľahaj a na rozpálenom woku alebo veľkej panvici s lyžicou oleja z nich urob tenkú omeletu. Vyber ju, zroluj a nakrájaj na prúžky.
steps.en: Beat the eggs and make a thin omelette in a hot wok or large frying pan with a spoonful of oil. Lift it out, roll it up and cut into strips.

steps.sk: Pridaj ďalšiu lyžicu oleja a kuracie mäso opekaj na vysokom ohni 5 až 6 minút, kým nie je dozlatista a vo vnútri prepečené. Pridaj nasekaný zázvor a cesnak, biele časti jarnej cibuľky a papriku na kocky a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Add another spoonful of oil and fry the chicken over a high heat for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and cooked through. Add the chopped ginger and garlic, the white parts of the spring onions and the diced pepper and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj zvyšný olej a ryžu, rozdrob ju varechou a opekaj 4 minúty, kým nie sú zrnká horúce a mierne chrumkavé. Vlej zvyšnú sójovú omáčku a sezamový olej a premiešaj.
steps.en: Add the remaining oil and the rice, break it up with a wooden spoon and fry for 4 minutes until the grains are hot and slightly crisp. Pour in the remaining soy sauce and the sesame oil and toss.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj prúžky omelety a zelené časti jarnej cibuľky a hneď podávaj. Vychladnutú ryžu skladuj v chladničke najviac 2 dni a prehrievaj ju dôkladne, kým nie je celá horúca.
steps.en: Stir in the omelette strips and the green parts of the spring onions and serve straight away. Store leftovers in the fridge for no more than 2 days and reheat until piping hot throughout.

title.sk: Ajiaco – kolumbijská kuracia polievka so zemiakmi
title.en: Ajiaco: Colombian chicken and potato soup

description.sk: Krémová polievka z dvoch druhov zemiakov s kuracím a kukuricou, so smotanou, kaparami a avokádom.
description.en: A creamy soup of two kinds of potato with chicken and corn, served with cream, capers and avocado.

steps.sk: Kuracie prsia daj do hrnca s 1,8 litra vody, bujónom, celou ošúpanou cibuľou, jarnou cibuľkou a cesnakom. Priveď do varu a var na miernom ohni 20 minút, kým nie je mäso v strede prepečené.
steps.en: Put the chicken in a pot with 1.8 litres of water, the stock cube, the whole peeled onion, the spring onions and the garlic. Bring to the boil and simmer gently for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through in the centre.

steps.sk: Mäso vyber a natrhaj na vlákna, cibuľu vyhoď. Múčne zemiaky nakrájaj na tenké plátky a pevné na kocky 3 cm a vsyp ich do vývaru spolu s oreganom a soľou.
steps.en: Lift out the chicken and shred it, discarding the onion. Slice the floury potatoes thinly and cut the waxy ones into 3 cm cubes, then add them to the broth with the oregano and salt.

steps.sk: Var 30 minút, kým sa tenké plátky úplne nerozvaria a polievku nezahustia, zatiaľ čo kocky zostanú celé. Ak treba, časť zemiakov roztlač varechou o stenu hrnca.
steps.en: Simmer for 30 minutes until the thin slices fall apart and thicken the soup while the cubes stay whole. If needed, crush some of the potatoes against the side of the pot with a wooden spoon.

steps.sk: Pridaj kukuricu a natrhané mäso a var ešte 5 minút. Nakoniec vmiešaj nasekaný koriander.
steps.en: Add the corn and the shredded chicken and simmer for 5 more minutes. Finally stir in the chopped coriander.

steps.sk: Podávaj horúce v miskách a na stôl polož smotanu, kapary a avokádo nakrájané na plátky, nech si každý pridá podľa chuti. Polievka vydrží v chladničke 3 dni, smotanu a avokádo pridávaj až pri podávaní.
steps.en: Serve hot in bowls and put the cream, capers and sliced avocado on the table for everyone to add as they like. The soup keeps in the fridge for 3 days; add the cream and avocado only when serving.

title.sk: Peruánsky quinoový šalát s fazuľou a kukuricou
title.en: Peruvian quinoa salad with beans and corn

description.sk: Vegánsky šalát z quinoy, čiernej fazule, kukurice a zeleniny s limetkovým dresingom a mätou.
description.en: A vegan salad of quinoa, black beans, corn and vegetables with a lime dressing and mint.

steps.sk: Quinou prepláchni na sitku studenou vodou, kým voda nie je číra, zmyje sa tak horkastý povlak. Daj ju do hrnca so 400 ml vody a štipkou soli, priveď do varu a var pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 12 minút, kým nevpije vodu.
steps.en: Rinse the quinoa in a sieve under cold water until it runs clear, which washes off the bitter coating. Put it in a pot with 400 ml of water and a pinch of salt, bring to the boil and simmer, covered, over a low heat for 12 minutes until the water is absorbed.

steps.sk: Odstav ju, nechaj 5 minút dôjsť pod pokrievkou, potom ju prečechraj vidličkou a rozlož na tanier vychladnúť. Do teplej quinoy zeleninu nepridávaj, zvädla by.
steps.en: Take it off the heat, leave it covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and spread on a plate to cool. Do not mix the vegetables into warm quinoa or they wilt.

steps.sk: Papriku, uhorku a cibuľu nakrájaj na drobné kocky, paradajky na štvrtiny a bylinky nasekaj. Na dresing vymiešaj šťavu z limetiek, olej, rascu a zvyšnú soľ.
steps.en: Dice the pepper, cucumber and onion small, quarter the tomatoes and chop the herbs. For the dressing whisk the lime juice with the oil, cumin and remaining salt.

steps.sk: Vo veľkej mise zmiešaj vychladnutú quinou, scedenú fazuľu, kukuricu, zeleninu a bylinky a prelej dresingom. Nechaj 10 minút odstáť, aby quinoa nasala chuť.
steps.en: In a large bowl combine the cooled quinoa, drained beans, corn, vegetables and herbs and pour over the dressing. Leave for 10 minutes so the quinoa soaks up the flavour.

steps.sk: Tesne pred podávaním pridaj avokádo nakrájané na kocky. Šalát bez avokáda vydrží v chladničke 3 dni a je ideálny do krabičky na obed.
steps.en: Add the diced avocado just before serving. Without the avocado the salad keeps in the fridge for 3 days and is ideal for packed lunches.

title.sk: Alfajores – krehké sušienky s karamelovým krémom
title.en: Alfajores: shortbread sandwiches with caramel

description.sk: Jemné škrobové sušienky spojené domácim dulce de leche a obalené v kokose.
description.en: Delicate cornflour biscuits sandwiched with homemade dulce de leche and rolled in coconut.

note.en: 1 can, for the dulce de leche

steps.sk: Kondenzované mlieko vlej do hrnca s hrubým dnom a za stáleho miešania ho var na miernom ohni 20 až 25 minút, kým nezhustne a nezíska karamelovú farbu. Preber ho do misky a nechaj vychladnúť, stuhne na hustý krém.
steps.en: Pour the condensed milk into a heavy-based pan and cook over a low heat, stirring constantly, for 20 to 25 minutes until thick and caramel-coloured. Transfer to a bowl and leave to cool; it sets into a thick cream.

steps.sk: Mäkké maslo vyšľahaj s práškovým a vanilkovým cukrom do peny, pridaj žĺtky a nastrúhanú citrónovú kôru. Preosej k tomu škrob, múku a prášok do pečiva a rýchlo vypracuj mäkké cesto. Zabaľ ho a daj na 30 minút do chladničky.
steps.en: Beat the soft butter with the icing sugar and vanilla sugar until fluffy, then add the yolks and grated lemon zest. Sift in the cornflour, flour and baking powder and quickly bring together into a soft dough. Wrap and chill for 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 170 °C. Cesto rozvaľkaj na pomúčenej doske na hrúbku 5 mm a vykrajuj kolieska s priemerom 5 cm. Ulož ich na plech s papierom na pečenie s malými rozostupmi.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 170 °C. Roll the dough out 5 mm thick on a floured board and cut out 5 cm rounds. Lay them on a lined baking tray, slightly apart.

steps.sk: Peč 10 až 12 minút, kým nie sú pevné, ale stále svetlé, nesmú zhnednúť. Na plechu ich nechaj 10 minút vychladnúť, teplé sú veľmi krehké a lámu sa.
steps.en: Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until firm but still pale; they must not brown. Leave them to cool on the tray for 10 minutes, as they are very fragile while warm.

steps.sk: Polovicu koliesok natri lyžičkou karamelového krému, prilož druhé koliesko a okraje obváľaj v kokose. Alfajores sú najlepšie na druhý deň, keď zmäknú; v uzavretej dóze vydržia 5 dní.
steps.en: Spread half the rounds with a teaspoon of the caramel, top with the other rounds and roll the edges in coconut. Alfajores are best the next day once they soften; they keep for 5 days in an airtight tin.

title.sk: Cocadas – kokosové kôpky s kondenzovaným mliekom
title.en: Cocadas: coconut bites with condensed milk

description.sk: Latinskoamerické kokosové sladkosti, navrchu zlatisté a vo vnútri vláčne.
description.en: Latin American coconut sweets, golden outside and chewy inside.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 170 °C a plech vystel papierom na pečenie. V hrnci na miernom ohni zohrievaj kondenzované mlieko s maslom a soľou, kým sa maslo nerozpustí.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 170 °C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Warm the condensed milk with the butter and salt in a pan over a low heat until the butter melts.

steps.sk: Vsyp kokos a za stáleho miešania var 5 minút, kým zmes nezhustne a nezačne sa odliepať od dna. Stiahni ju z ohňa, nechaj 5 minút vychladnúť a vmiešaj žĺtok a nastrúhanú limetkovú kôru.
steps.en: Tip in the coconut and cook, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens and starts to come away from the bottom. Take it off the heat, cool for 5 minutes and stir in the yolk and grated lime zest.

steps.sk: Navlhčenými rukami alebo dvoma lyžičkami tvaruj kôpky veľkosti vlašského orecha a klaď ich na plech s rozostupmi 3 cm, pri pečení sa trochu roztečú.
steps.en: With damp hands or two teaspoons shape walnut-sized mounds and set them on the tray 3 cm apart, as they spread a little while baking.

steps.sk: Peč 15 až 18 minút, kým nie sú navrchu a na spodku zlatisté, vo vnútri ostanú mäkké a vláčne. Nechaj ich vychladnúť na plechu, teplé sa rozpadajú. V uzavretej dóze vydržia 5 dní.
steps.en: Bake for 15 to 18 minutes until golden on top and underneath; the inside stays soft and chewy. Let them cool on the tray, as they crumble while warm. They keep for 5 days in an airtight tin.

title.sk: Pan con chicharrón – peruánsky sendvič s bravčovým a batátom
title.en: Pan con chicharrón: Peruvian pork and sweet potato sandwich

description.sk: Bravčové uvarené a opečené vo vlastnom tuku, s plátkami batátu a cibuľovou salsou v rožku.
description.en: Pork simmered and then crisped in its own fat, with sweet potato slices and onion salsa in a roll.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kocky 3 cm, daj ho do širokého hrnca s prelisovaným cesnakom, rascou a soľou a zalej vodou tak, aby bolo len ponorené. Var bez pokrievky na miernom ohni 50 minút, kým sa voda neodparí a mäso nezmäkne.
steps.en: Cut the pork into 3 cm cubes, put them in a wide pot with the crushed garlic, cumin and salt and add water just to cover. Simmer uncovered over a low heat for 50 minutes until the water has evaporated and the meat is tender.

steps.sk: Keď sa voda odparí, pridaj olej a mäso opekaj vo vlastnom tuku 10 minút, často ho obracaj, kým nie je zo všetkých strán chrumkavé a zlatohnedé.
steps.en: Once the water has gone, add the oil and fry the pork in its own fat for 10 minutes, turning often, until crisp and golden brown on all sides.

steps.sk: Batát ošúp, nakrájaj na plátky hrubé 5 mm a opeč ich v druhej panvici s trochou tuku z mäsa 3 až 4 minúty z každej strany, kým nie sú mäkké a opečené.
steps.en: Peel the sweet potato, cut it into 5 mm slices and fry them in a second pan with a little of the pork fat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until tender and browned.

steps.sk: Na salsu criolla nakrájaj cibuľu na tenké polkolieska, prepláchni ju studenou vodou a premiešaj so šťavou z limetiek, nasekaným čili a koriandrom. Nechaj ju aspoň 5 minút odstáť.
steps.en: For the salsa criolla slice the onion into thin half-moons, rinse under cold water and toss with the lime juice, chopped chilli and coriander. Leave to stand for at least 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Rožky prekroj a zohrej, poukladaj do nich plátky batátu, mäso a salsu. Podávaj hneď, kým je mäso chrumkavé; zvyšné mäso vydrží v chladničke 3 dni a pred podávaním ho znova opeč.
steps.en: Split and warm the rolls and fill with the sweet potato slices, pork and salsa. Serve straight away while the pork is crisp; leftover pork keeps in the fridge for 3 days and should be fried again before serving.

title.sk: Papa a la huancaína – zemiaky v syrovej omáčke s čili
title.en: Papa a la huancaína: potatoes in chilli cheese sauce

description.sk: Peruánske varené zemiaky so žltou krémovou omáčkou zo syra a čili, s vajcom a olivami.
description.en: Peruvian boiled potatoes with a creamy yellow sauce of cheese and chilli, with egg and olives.

steps.sk: Zemiaky v šupke daj do hrnca so studenou vodou a soľou, priveď do varu a var 20 až 25 minút, kým do nich nôž nevkĺzne bez odporu. Vajcia uvar natvrdo 10 minút a ochlaď ich v studenej vode.
steps.en: Put the potatoes in their skins in a pot of cold water with the salt, bring to the boil and cook for 20 to 25 minutes until a knife slides in without resistance. Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes and cool them in cold water.

steps.sk: Čili zbav semienok a nasekaj ho, potom ho s cesnakom opeč na lyžici oleja na miernom ohni 2 minúty, aby zjemnelo a nebolo surovo štipľavé.
steps.en: Deseed and chop the chilli, then fry it with the garlic in a spoonful of oil over a low heat for 2 minutes to mellow its raw heat.

steps.sk: Do mixéra daj čili s cesnakom, rozdrobený syr, mlieko, natrhaný chlieb, kurkumu a zvyšný olej a mixuj dohladka. Omáčka má byť hustá ako majonéza; ak je redšia, pridaj kúsok chleba, ak hustejšia, lyžicu mlieka.
steps.en: Put the chilli and garlic, crumbled cheese, milk, torn bread, turmeric and remaining oil in a blender and blend until smooth. The sauce should be as thick as mayonnaise; if thinner add a little bread, if thicker a spoonful of milk.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj na hrubé kolieska a poukladaj ich na tanier na listy šalátu. Prelej ich žltou omáčkou a ozdob štvrtinami vajec a olivami.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, cut them into thick rounds and arrange on a plate on lettuce leaves. Pour over the yellow sauce and garnish with egg quarters and olives.

steps.sk: Podávaj vlažné alebo studené ako ľahký obed či predjedlo. Samotná omáčka vydrží v uzavretej nádobe v chladničke 3 dni a hodí sa aj k pečenému mäsu či zelenine.
steps.en: Serve warm or cold as a light lunch or starter. The sauce on its own keeps in a closed container in the fridge for 3 days and also goes well with roast meat or vegetables.

title.sk: Choripán – argentínska klobása v rožku s chimichurri
title.en: Choripán: Argentine sausage roll with chimichurri

description.sk: Grilovaná rozložená klobása v chrumkavom rožku s bylinkovou omáčkou chimichurri.
description.en: Grilled butterflied sausage in a crusty roll with herby chimichurri sauce.

steps.sk: Na chimichurri nasekaj nadrobno petržlenovú vňať a cesnak a zmiešaj ich s oreganom, čili, octom, olejom, soľou a 2 lyžicami teplej vody. Nechaj aspoň 20 minút odstáť, aby sa chute spojili.
steps.en: For the chimichurri finely chop the parsley and garlic and mix with the oregano, chilli, vinegar, oil, salt and 2 tablespoons of warm water. Leave for at least 20 minutes for the flavours to come together.

steps.sk: Klobásy prekroj pozdĺžne, ale nie celkom, aby sa dali rozložiť ako kniha. Rozpáľ grilovaciu panvicu alebo gril na strednom ohni, na príliš silnom by klobásy zvonku zhoreli a vo vnútri ostali studené.
steps.en: Cut the sausages lengthways without cutting all the way through so they open like a book. Heat a griddle pan or grill to medium; on too high a heat the sausages burn outside while staying cold inside.

steps.sk: Klobásy opekaj reznou stranou nadol 4 minúty, potom ich obráť a opekaj ďalšie 3 až 4 minúty, kým nie sú opečené a v strede horúce.
steps.en: Grill the sausages cut side down for 4 minutes, then turn and cook for 3 to 4 more minutes until browned and hot in the centre.

steps.sk: Rožky prekroj a krátko ich opeč reznou stranou na panvici, kým nezačnú chrumkať. Paradajky nakrájaj na plátky.
steps.en: Split the rolls and toast them briefly cut side down in the pan until crisp. Slice the tomatoes.

steps.sk: Do rožkov polož paradajky a klobásy a bohato ich polej chimichurri. Jedz hneď, kým je pečivo chrumkavé; zvyšné chimichurri vydrží v uzavretom pohári v chladničke 5 dní.
steps.en: Fill the rolls with the tomatoes and sausages and spoon over plenty of chimichurri. Eat straight away while the bread is crisp; leftover chimichurri keeps in a closed jar in the fridge for 5 days.

title.sk: Gumbo s kuracím a klobásou
title.en: Chicken and sausage gumbo

description.sk: Louisianský hustý guláš na tmavej zápražke s kuracím, údenou klobásou, zeleninou a ryžou.
description.en: A thick Louisiana stew on a dark roux with chicken, smoked sausage, vegetables and rice.

steps.sk: Na zápražku (roux) zohrej olej v hrnci s hrubým dnom, vmiešaj múku a za stáleho miešania ju praž na strednom až miernom ohni 15 až 18 minút, kým nemá farbu mliečnej čokolády a nevonia orieškovo. Ak sa objavia čierne bodky, pripálila sa a treba začať znova.
steps.en: For the roux heat the oil in a heavy-based pot, stir in the flour and cook over a medium-low heat, stirring constantly, for 15 to 18 minutes until it is the colour of milk chocolate and smells nutty. If black specks appear it has burnt and you need to start again.

steps.sk: Pridaj nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu, papriku a stopkový zeler a opekaj 6 minút, kým nezmäknú. Potom pridaj nasekaný cesnak, tymian, údenú papriku a čili a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Add the finely chopped onion, pepper and celery and fry for 6 minutes until soft. Then add the chopped garlic, thyme, smoked paprika and chilli and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Postupne prilievaj 1,2 litra horúcej vody s rozpusteným bujónom a stále miešaj, aby nevznikli hrudky. Pridaj paradajky, bobkové listy, kuracie mäso nakrájané na kúsky 3 cm a klobásu na kolieska.
steps.en: Gradually pour in 1.2 litres of hot water with the stock cube dissolved in it, stirring all the time so no lumps form. Add the tomatoes, bay leaves, the chicken cut into 3 cm pieces and the sausage in rounds.

steps.sk: Var bez pokrievky na miernom ohni 40 minút a občas premiešaj. Posledných 10 minút pridaj fazuľku nakrájanú na 2 cm. Kuracie mäso má byť mäkké a gumbo zhustnuté ako omáčka.
steps.en: Simmer uncovered over a low heat for 40 minutes, stirring now and then. Add the green beans cut into 2 cm lengths for the last 10 minutes. The chicken should be tender and the gumbo thickened like a sauce.

steps.sk: Ryžu uvar podľa návodu na obale. Gumbo podávaj v miskách na kôpke ryže, posypané nasekanou jarnou cibuľkou. Vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a bez ryže sa dá zamraziť.
steps.en: Cook the rice according to the packet. Serve the gumbo in bowls over a mound of rice, sprinkled with chopped spring onion. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days and freezes well without the rice.

title.sk: Buffalo karfiol s jogurtovým dipom
title.en: Buffalo cauliflower with yogurt dip

description.sk: Pečené ružičky karfiolu v cestíčku, glazované pikantnou maslovou omáčkou, s dipom z nivy.
description.en: Battered roasted cauliflower florets glazed in a spicy butter sauce, with a blue cheese dip.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C a plech vystel papierom na pečenie. Karfiol rozober na ružičky veľké ako sústo. Z múky, mlieka, cesnakového prášku, údenej papriky a soli vymiešaj husté cestíčko ako na palacinky.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C and line a tray with baking paper. Break the cauliflower into bite-sized florets. Whisk the flour, milk, garlic powder, smoked paprika and salt into a thick batter like pancake batter.

steps.sk: Ružičky obaľ v cestíčku, nechaj prebytok odkvapkať a rozlož ich na plech tak, aby sa nedotýkali. Peč 20 minút, v polovici ich obráť, kým nie sú zlatisté a pevné.
steps.en: Coat the florets in the batter, let the excess drip off and spread them on the tray so they do not touch. Bake for 20 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and set.

steps.sk: Medzitým v hrnčeku rozpusti maslo a vmiešaj čili omáčku a med. Upečený karfiol prelej omáčkou v mise, premiešaj a vráť ho na plech ešte na 8 minút, kým glazúra nezaschne a okraje nie sú chrumkavé.
steps.en: Meanwhile melt the butter in a small pan and stir in the chilli sauce and honey. Toss the baked cauliflower in the sauce in a bowl and return it to the tray for 8 more minutes until the glaze sets and the edges crisp.

steps.sk: Na dip zmiešaj jogurt s rozdrobenou nivou a citrónovou šťavou. Zeler a mrkvu nakrájaj na tyčinky dlhé asi 8 cm.
steps.en: For the dip mix the yogurt with the crumbled blue cheese and the lemon juice. Cut the celery and carrots into sticks about 8 cm long.

steps.sk: Karfiol podávaj horúci s dipom a zeleninovými tyčinkami. Najlepší je hneď, postátím mäkne; zvyšky zohrej v rúre, v mikrovlnke by zmäkli ešte viac.
steps.en: Serve the cauliflower hot with the dip and vegetable sticks. It is best straight away as it softens on standing; reheat leftovers in the oven, as the microwave makes them softer still.

title.sk: Rybací chowder s treskou a zemiakmi
title.en: Cod and potato chowder

description.sk: Krémová polievka z Nového Anglicka s treskou, zemiakmi, slaninou a tymianom.
description.en: A creamy New England soup with cod, potatoes, bacon and thyme.

steps.sk: Slaninu nakrájaj na drobné kocky a opekaj ju v hrnci na strednom ohni 5 minút, kým nepustí tuk a nie je chrumkavá. Polovicu vyber na posypanie.
steps.en: Dice the bacon small and fry it in a pot over a medium heat for 5 minutes until it releases its fat and turns crisp. Lift out half for sprinkling.

steps.sk: K slanine pridaj maslo, nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu a stopkový zeler a opekaj 6 minút do mäkka. Vmiešaj múku a minútu ju opekaj, aby polievka potom nechutila múčne.
steps.en: Add the butter, finely chopped onion and celery to the bacon and fry for 6 minutes until soft. Stir in the flour and cook for a minute so the soup does not taste floury.

steps.sk: Za stáleho miešania prilej 300 ml vody s bujónom a mlieko, pridaj zemiaky nakrájané na kocky 1,5 cm, tymian, bobkový list a soľ. Var na miernom ohni 15 minút, kým nie sú zemiaky mäkké; polievku nenechaj prudko vrieť, mlieko by sa mohlo zraziť.
steps.en: Stirring constantly, pour in 300 ml of water with the stock and the milk, then add the potatoes cut into 1.5 cm cubes, the thyme, bay leaf and salt. Simmer gently for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender; do not let it boil hard or the milk may curdle.

steps.sk: Rybu nakrájaj na kocky 3 cm, vlož ju do polievky spolu so smotanou a var tesne pod bodom varu 5 minút, kým nie je ryba v strede biela a nezačne sa rozpadať na lupienky.
steps.en: Cut the fish into 3 cm chunks, add it to the soup with the cream and cook just below a simmer for 5 minutes until the fish is white in the centre and starts to flake.

steps.sk: Dochuť korením, posyp nasekanou petržlenovou vňaťou a odloženou slaninou. Polievka vydrží v chladničke 2 dni; prehrievaj ju pomaly a nevar.
steps.en: Season with pepper and sprinkle with chopped parsley and the reserved bacon. The soup keeps in the fridge for 2 days; reheat it gently without boiling.

title.sk: BBQ kuracie stehná so zemiakmi z rúry
title.en: Oven BBQ chicken thighs with potatoes

description.sk: Stehná pečené s domácou údenou BBQ glazúrou a zemiakovými mesiačikmi na jednom plechu.
description.en: Thighs roasted with a homemade smoky BBQ glaze and potato wedges on one tray.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Na BBQ omáčku zmiešaj v hrnčeku kečup, cukor, ocot, horčicu, sójovú omáčku, polovicu údenej papriky, cesnakový prášok a čili a var na miernom ohni 5 minút, kým nezhustne.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. For the BBQ sauce mix the ketchup, sugar, vinegar, mustard, soy sauce, half the smoked paprika, the garlic powder and chilli in a small pan and simmer for 5 minutes until thick.

steps.sk: Stehná osuš papierovou utierkou, potri zvyšnou paprikou a polovicou soli a ulož ich kožou nahor na plech. Zemiaky nakrájaj na mesiačiky, premiešaj s olejom a zvyšnou soľou a rozlož okolo mäsa.
steps.en: Pat the thighs dry with kitchen paper, rub with the remaining paprika and half the salt and lay them skin side up on a tray. Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with the oil and remaining salt and spread around the chicken.

steps.sk: Peč 30 minút, potom stehná potri polovicou omáčky a peč ďalších 10 minút.
steps.en: Roast for 30 minutes, then brush the thighs with half the sauce and roast for another 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Potri ich zvyškom omáčky a peč ešte 5 až 10 minút, kým glazúra nie je lepkavá a tmavá a šťava pri prepichnutí mäsa pri kosti nie je číra, bez ružovej farby.
steps.en: Brush with the rest of the sauce and roast for 5 to 10 more minutes until the glaze is sticky and dark and the juices run clear, not pink, when pierced near the bone.

steps.sk: Nechaj 5 minút odpočívať a podávaj so zemiakmi a coleslawom alebo zeleným šalátom. Stehná vydržia v chladničke 3 dni a výborné sú aj studené.
steps.en: Rest for 5 minutes and serve with the potatoes and coleslaw or a green salad. The thighs keep in the fridge for 3 days and are also great cold.

title.sk: Zapečený sendvič s mäsovými guľkami
title.en: Baked meatball sub

description.sk: Bagety plnené hovädzími guľkami v paradajkovej omáčke, zapečené s mozzarellou.
description.en: Baguettes filled with beef meatballs in tomato sauce, grilled with mozzarella.

steps.sk: Mäso zmiešaj so strúhankou, vajcom, parmezánom, prelisovaným cesnakom, oreganom a soľou. Navlhčenými rukami vytvaruj 16 guliek veľkosti vlašského orecha.
steps.en: Mix the beef with the breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, crushed garlic, oregano and salt. With damp hands shape 16 walnut-sized balls.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozohrej olej a guľky opekaj na strednom ohni 6 minút, obracaj ich, kým nie sú zo všetkých strán opečené. Vyber ich a na výpekoch opeč nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu 4 minúty.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan and brown the meatballs over a medium heat for 6 minutes, turning, until browned all over. Lift them out and fry the finely chopped onion in the pan juices for 4 minutes.

steps.sk: Vlej passatu, priveď do varu, vráť guľky do omáčky a var pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 12 minút, kým nie sú v strede prepečené a omáčka nezhustne. Vmiešaj natrhanú bazalku.
steps.en: Pour in the passata, bring to the boil, return the meatballs to the sauce and simmer, covered, over a low heat for 12 minutes until cooked through and the sauce has thickened. Stir in the torn basil.

steps.sk: Rúru zapni na gril. Bagetky prekroj pozdĺžne, ale nie celkom, naplň ich guľkami s omáčkou a navrch poukladaj plátky mozzarelly.
steps.en: Turn the oven grill on. Split the rolls lengthways without cutting all the way through, fill with the meatballs and sauce and lay slices of mozzarella on top.

steps.sk: Zapekaj pod grilom 3 až 4 minúty, kým sa syr neroztopí a nezačne hnednúť. Jedz hneď; samotné guľky v omáčke vydržia v chladničke 3 dni a dajú sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Grill for 3 to 4 minutes until the cheese melts and starts to brown. Eat straight away; the meatballs in sauce on their own keep in the fridge for 3 days and freeze well.

title.sk: Tuna melt – opečený sendvič s tuniakom a cheddarom
title.en: Tuna melt with cheddar

description.sk: Chrumkavý sendvič z panvice s krémovým tuniakovým šalátom a roztopeným syrom.
description.en: A crisp pan-fried sandwich with creamy tuna salad and melted cheese.

steps.sk: Tuniaka dobre sceď a vidličkou ho rozdrob v miske. Stopkový zeler, cibuľu a uhorku nakrájaj na veľmi drobné kocky, aby plnka nebola hrudkovitá.
steps.en: Drain the tuna well and flake it with a fork in a bowl. Cut the celery, onion and pickle into very small dice so the filling is not lumpy.

steps.sk: K tuniakovi pridaj majonézu, jogurt, horčicu, nakrájanú zeleninu, citrónovú šťavu a čierne korenie a premiešaj na hustú plnku. Nesmie byť vodnatá, inak by chlieb rozmočila.
steps.en: Add the mayonnaise, yogurt, mustard, chopped vegetables, lemon juice and black pepper to the tuna and mix into a thick filling. It must not be watery or it soaks the bread.

steps.sk: Na štyri plátky chleba rozotri plnku, posyp nastrúhaným cheddarom a prikry zvyšnými plátkami. Sendviče zvonka natri tenkou vrstvou mäkkého masla.
steps.en: Spread the filling over four slices of bread, sprinkle with grated cheddar and top with the remaining slices. Spread the outsides thinly with the soft butter.

steps.sk: Na panvici na strednom ohni opekaj sendviče 3 až 4 minúty z každej strany, kým nie sú zlatohnedé a syr vo vnútri sa neroztopí. Pritlač ich obracačkou, aby sa spojili.
steps.en: Fry the sandwiches in a pan over a medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden brown and the cheese inside has melted. Press them down with a spatula so they hold together.

steps.sk: Prekroj ich šikmo na polovice a podávaj teplé so zeleninou alebo nakladanou uhorkou. Plnka vydrží v chladničke 2 dni, sendviče opekaj vždy čerstvé.
steps.en: Cut them diagonally in half and serve warm with salad or a pickle. The filling keeps in the fridge for 2 days; always fry the sandwiches fresh.

title.sk: Waldorfský šalát s kuracím a orechmi
title.en: Waldorf salad with chicken and walnuts

description.sk: Chrumkavý šalát z jabĺk, zeleru, pražených orechov a kuracieho mäsa v jogurtovom dresingu.
description.en: A crunchy salad of apple, celery, toasted walnuts and chicken in a yogurt dressing.

steps.sk: Kuracie prsia osoľ polovicou soli a opeč na oleji na strednom ohni 6 až 7 minút z každej strany, kým nie sú v strede prepečené a šťava nie je číra. Nechaj ich vychladnúť a nakrájaj na kocky.
steps.en: Season the chicken with half the salt and fry in the oil over a medium heat for 6 to 7 minutes per side until cooked through and the juices run clear. Let it cool and cut into cubes.

steps.sk: Orechy opraž na suchej panvici 3 až 4 minúty, kým nezavoňajú, a nahrubo ich nasekaj. Hrozienka zalej na 5 minút teplou vodou, aby napučali, a sceď ich.
steps.en: Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 3 to 4 minutes until fragrant and chop roughly. Soak the raisins in warm water for 5 minutes to plump them up, then drain.

steps.sk: Jablká zbav jadrovníkov, nakrájaj na kocky 1 cm a hneď ich pokvapkaj šťavou z polovice citróna, aby nezhnedli. Stopkový zeler nakrájaj na tenké plátky.
steps.en: Core the apples, cut into 1 cm cubes and sprinkle at once with the juice of half the lemon so they do not brown. Slice the celery thinly.

steps.sk: Zmiešaj jogurt s majonézou, zvyšnou citrónovou šťavou, zvyšnou soľou a korením. Pridaj kuracie mäso, jablká, zeler, hrozienka a väčšinu orechov a premiešaj.
steps.en: Mix the yogurt with the mayonnaise, the remaining lemon juice, the remaining salt and the pepper. Add the chicken, apples, celery, raisins and most of the walnuts and stir.

steps.sk: Podávaj na listoch šalátu, posypané zvyšnými orechmi. Šalát vydrží v chladničke 2 dni, listy šalátu pridávaj až pri podávaní.
steps.en: Serve on lettuce leaves, sprinkled with the remaining walnuts. The salad keeps in the fridge for 2 days; add the lettuce only when serving.

title.sk: Cajunský losos s kukuričnou salsou
title.en: Cajun salmon with corn salsa

description.sk: Losos v údenom cajunskom korení opečený do kôrky, so salsou z kukurice, papriky a avokáda.
description.en: Salmon seared in a smoky Cajun spice crust, with a corn, pepper and avocado salsa.

steps.sk: Ryžu daj variť podľa návodu na obale. V miske zmiešaj údenú papriku, cesnakový prášok, tymian, oregano, čili, cukor a polovicu soli na cajunské korenie.
steps.en: Put the rice on to cook according to the packet. In a bowl mix the smoked paprika, garlic powder, thyme, oregano, chilli, sugar and half the salt into a Cajun seasoning.

steps.sk: Na salsu nakrájaj papriku, cibuľu a avokádo na drobné kocky a zmiešaj ich s kukuricou, šťavou z limetky, nasekaným koriandrom, lyžicou oleja a zvyšnou soľou.
steps.en: For the salsa dice the pepper, onion and avocado small and mix with the corn, lime juice, chopped coriander, a spoonful of the oil and the remaining salt.

steps.sk: Lososa osuš papierovou utierkou, potri ho zvyšným olejom a zo strany bez kože ho obaľ v korení, aby sa vytvorila súvislá vrstva.
steps.en: Pat the salmon dry with kitchen paper, brush with the remaining oil and coat the flesh side with the seasoning in an even layer.

steps.sk: Panvicu rozohrej na stredne vysokom ohni a lososa opekaj korením nadol 3 minúty, kým sa nevytvorí tmavá chrumkavá kôrka. Obráť ho a opekaj 3 až 4 minúty, kým nie je v strede ešte jemne ružový a ľahko sa rozpadá na lupienky.
steps.en: Heat a frying pan over a medium-high heat and sear the salmon spice side down for 3 minutes until a dark crisp crust forms. Turn and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until just pink in the centre and flaking easily.

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou a kukuričnou salsou. Korenie môže na panvici trochu dymiť, to je v poriadku; ak však začne horieť, zmierni oheň. Losos vydrží v chladničke 2 dni.
steps.en: Serve with the rice and corn salsa. The spices may smoke a little in the pan, which is fine; if they start to burn, lower the heat. The salmon keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

title.sk: Kuracia polievka s nadýchanými knedličkami
title.en: Chicken and dumplings

description.sk: Americká domáca klasika: hustá kuracia polievka so zeleninou a parenými knedličkami z cesta.
description.en: An American homestyle classic: thick chicken soup with vegetables and steamed dumplings.

note.sk: 10 g na zeleninu, 20 g do knedličiek
note.en: 10 g for the vegetables, 20 g for the dumplings

note.sk: 30 g do polievky, 160 g do knedličiek
note.en: 30 g for the soup, 160 g for the dumplings

steps.sk: V hrnci rozpusti 10 g masla a opekaj na ňom nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu a mrkvu so stopkovým zelerom na kolieska 6 minút. Pridaj nasekaný cesnak, vmiešaj 30 g múky a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Melt 10 g of butter in a pot and fry the finely chopped onion with the carrots and celery cut into rounds for 6 minutes. Add the chopped garlic, stir in 30 g of flour and cook for a minute.

steps.sk: Za stáleho miešania prilej 1,5 litra vody, pridaj bujón, tymian, bobkový list a kuracie stehná vcelku. Priveď do varu a var na miernom ohni 25 minút, kým nie je mäso mäkké.
steps.en: Stirring constantly, pour in 1.5 litres of water and add the stock cube, thyme, bay leaf and whole chicken thighs. Bring to the boil and simmer gently for 25 minutes until the chicken is tender.

steps.sk: Medzitým priprav cesto na knedličky: zmiešaj 160 g múky, prášok do pečiva a soľ, pridaj 20 g rozpusteného masla a mlieko a len krátko premiešaj na hustú lepkavú hmotu. Dlhé miešanie by knedličky urobilo tuhými.
steps.en: Meanwhile make the dumpling dough: mix 160 g of flour with the baking powder and salt, add 20 g of melted butter and the milk and stir briefly into a thick sticky dough. Overmixing makes the dumplings tough.

steps.sk: Mäso vyber, natrhaj ho na kúsky a vráť do polievky spolu s hráškom. Do mierne vriacej polievky klaď lyžicou kôpky cesta veľkosti vlašského orecha.
steps.en: Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the soup with the peas. Drop walnut-sized spoonfuls of the dough into the gently simmering soup.

steps.sk: Prikry a var 15 minút bez odkrývania, kým knedličky nie sú nadýchané a v strede suché, over to prekrojením jednej. Posyp petržlenovou vňaťou a podávaj horúce; polievka je najlepšia v deň prípravy.
steps.en: Cover and simmer for 15 minutes without lifting the lid until the dumplings are fluffy and dry in the middle; check by cutting one open. Sprinkle with parsley and serve hot; it is best on the day it is made.

title.sk: Plnené pečené zemiaky so slaninou a brokolicou
title.en: Loaded baked potatoes with bacon and broccoli

description.sk: Celé zemiaky pečené do chrumkava, plnené brokolicou, slaninou, cheddarom a kyslou smotanou.
description.en: Whole potatoes baked until crisp, loaded with broccoli, bacon, cheddar and sour cream.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Zemiaky umy, osuš, niekoľkokrát prepichni vidličkou, potri olejom a polovicou soli a ulož ich priamo na mriežku v rúre, pod ňu daj plech.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Scrub and dry the potatoes, prick them several times with a fork, rub with the oil and half the salt and place directly on the oven rack with a tray underneath.

steps.sk: Peč 60 až 70 minút, kým nemajú chrumkavú šupku a špajľa nimi neprejde bez odporu.
steps.en: Bake for 60 to 70 minutes until the skins are crisp and a skewer slides through without resistance.

steps.sk: Medzitým opeč slaninu nakrájanú na prúžky na suchej panvici 5 minút dochrumkava. Brokolicu rozober na malé ružičky a uvar ju v pare alebo vo vode 3 minúty, aby zostala chrumkavá.
steps.en: Meanwhile fry the bacon, cut into strips, in a dry pan for 5 minutes until crisp. Break the broccoli into small florets and steam or boil for 3 minutes so it stays crunchy.

steps.sk: Upečené zemiaky prekroj navrchu do kríža a stlač ich zo strán, aby sa otvorili. Do každého daj kúsok masla, zvyšnú soľ a korenie a vidličkou to zľahka premiešaj s dužinou.
steps.en: Cut a cross in the top of each baked potato and squeeze the sides to open it. Add a knob of butter, the remaining salt and the pepper to each and lightly fork it into the flesh.

steps.sk: Naplň ich brokolicou, slaninou a nastrúhaným syrom a vráť do rúry na 5 minút, kým sa syr neroztopí. Podávaj s lyžicou kyslej smotany a nasekanou pažítkou.
steps.en: Fill with the broccoli, bacon and grated cheese and return to the oven for 5 minutes until the cheese melts. Serve with a spoonful of sour cream and chopped chives.

title.sk: Raňajková zapekanka s chlebom, šunkou a špenátom
title.en: Breakfast strata with bread, ham and spinach

description.sk: Chlieb nasiaknutý vajíčkami a mliekom, zapečený so šunkou, cheddarom a špenátom – pripravíš ju večer.
description.en: Bread soaked in eggs and milk, baked with ham, cheddar and spinach; assemble it the night before.

steps.sk: Zapekaciu misu s rozmermi asi 20 × 30 cm vymasti maslom. Chlieb nakrájaj na kocky 2 cm, šunku na prúžky a jarnú cibuľku nadrobno. Špenát krátko spar vriacou vodou, vytlač z neho vodu a nahrubo ho nasekaj.
steps.en: Butter a baking dish of about 20 × 30 cm. Cut the bread into 2 cm cubes, the ham into strips and the spring onions finely. Blanch the spinach briefly in boiling water, squeeze out the water and chop roughly.

steps.sk: Do misy rozlož polovicu chleba, posyp ho polovicou šunky, špenátu, cibuľky a nastrúhaného syra a zopakuj ešte jednu vrstvu.
steps.en: Spread half the bread in the dish, scatter over half the ham, spinach, spring onion and grated cheese and repeat with a second layer.

steps.sk: Vajcia rozšľahaj s mliekom, horčicou, soľou a korením a rovnomerne prelej chlieb. Zľahka ho pritlač, aby nasiakol, prikry a nechaj aspoň 30 minút alebo cez noc v chladničke.
steps.en: Whisk the eggs with the milk, mustard, salt and pepper and pour evenly over the bread. Press it down gently so it soaks up the liquid, cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C. Zapekanku peč 40 až 45 minút, kým nie je nafúknutá a zlatistá a nôž zapichnutý do stredu nevyjde suchý, bez tekutých vajec.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Bake the strata for 40 to 45 minutes until puffed and golden and a knife inserted in the centre comes out clean, with no runny egg.

steps.sk: Nechaj ju 10 minút postáť a nakrájaj na porcie. Vydrží v chladničke 3 dni, porcie zohrej v mikrovlnke alebo v rúre.
steps.en: Leave to stand for 10 minutes, then cut into portions. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days; reheat portions in the microwave or oven.

title.sk: Broskyňový cobbler
title.en: Peach cobbler

description.sk: Šťavnaté broskyne so škoricou zapečené pod kôpkami mäkkého maslového cesta.
description.en: Juicy cinnamon peaches baked under mounds of soft buttery dough.

note.sk: 30 g k broskyniam, 50 g do cesta
note.en: 30 g for the peaches, 50 g for the dough
