steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C. Broskyne nakrájaj na mesiačiky, šupku môžeš nechať. Premiešaj ich s 30 g cukru, citrónovou šťavou, škrobom a škoricou a rozlož do zapekacej misy.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Slice the peaches into wedges; you can leave the skin on. Toss them with 30 g of sugar, the lemon juice, cornflour and cinnamon and spread in a baking dish.

steps.sk: V mise zmiešaj múku, 50 g cukru, vanilkový cukor, prášok do pečiva a soľ. Pridaj studené maslo nakrájané na kocky a rozotri ho prstami na hrubé drobky.
steps.en: In a bowl mix the flour, 50 g of sugar, the vanilla sugar, baking powder and salt. Add the cold butter in cubes and rub it in with your fingertips to coarse crumbs.

steps.sk: Vlej mlieko a vidličkou len krátko premiešaj na mäkké lepkavé cesto. Lyžicou ho klaď na broskyne v kôpkach a medzi nimi nechaj medzery, aby ovocie mohlo bublať.
steps.en: Pour in the milk and stir briefly with a fork into a soft sticky dough. Spoon it over the peaches in mounds, leaving gaps between them so the fruit can bubble up.

steps.sk: Peč 35 až 40 minút, kým nie je povrch zlatohnedý a šťava z broskýň po okrajoch nehustne a nebublá. Špajľa zapichnutá do cesta musí vyjsť suchá.
steps.en: Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until the top is golden brown and the peach juices are thick and bubbling at the edges. A skewer pushed into the dough should come out dry.

steps.sk: Nechaj 15 minút vychladnúť, aby šťava zhustla, a podávaj vlažné, napríklad s jogurtom alebo kopčekom zmrzliny. V chladničke vydrží 2 dni.
steps.en: Leave to cool for 15 minutes so the juices thicken and serve warm, for example with yogurt or a scoop of ice cream. It keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

title.sk: Krevety s krémovou syrovou polentou
title.en: Shrimp and cheesy grits

description.sk: Klasika amerického juhu: krevety so slaninou a paprikou na krémovej polente s cheddarom.
description.en: A Southern classic: prawns with bacon and pepper on creamy cheddar polenta.

steps.sk: V hrnci priveď do varu mlieko so 600 ml vody a soľou. Za stáleho miešania metličkou pomaly sypi polentu tenkým prúdom, aby nevznikli hrudky.
steps.en: Bring the milk to the boil in a pot with 600 ml of water and the salt. Whisking constantly, slowly pour in the polenta in a thin stream so no lumps form.

steps.sk: Var na miernom ohni podľa obalu, zvyčajne 10 až 15 minút, a často miešaj varechou, kým nie je polenta hustá a krémová. Vmiešaj polovicu masla a nastrúhaný cheddar a prikry.
steps.en: Cook over a low heat according to the packet, usually 10 to 15 minutes, stirring often with a wooden spoon, until thick and creamy. Stir in half the butter and the grated cheddar and cover.

steps.sk: Na panvici opeč slaninu nakrájanú na prúžky 5 minút dochrumkava a vyber ju. Na výpekoch opekaj papriku nakrájanú na kocky 4 minúty.
steps.en: Fry the bacon cut into strips in a frying pan for 5 minutes until crisp and lift it out. Fry the diced pepper in the fat for 4 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj zvyšné maslo, nasekaný cesnak, údenú papriku a krevety a opekaj 3 minúty, kým krevety nie sú ružové a stočené. Pokvapkaj citrónovou šťavou a vráť slaninu.
steps.en: Add the remaining butter, the chopped garlic, smoked paprika and prawns and fry for 3 minutes until the prawns are pink and curled. Squeeze over the lemon juice and return the bacon.

steps.sk: Polentu rozdeľ do hlbokých tanierov, navrch daj krevety s výpekom a posyp jarnou cibuľkou. Podávaj hneď, polenta postátím tuhne; ak zhustne, rozmiešaj ju s trochou horúcej vody.
steps.en: Divide the polenta between deep plates, top with the prawns and pan juices and sprinkle with spring onion. Serve straight away, as polenta sets on standing; if it thickens, loosen it with a little hot water.

title.sk: Kukuričný chlieb (cornbread)
title.en: Cornbread

description.sk: Vláčny a jemne sladký americký chlieb z kukuričnej múky a cmaru, pečený v horúcej forme.
description.en: A tender, lightly sweet American bread of cornmeal and buttermilk, baked in a hot tin.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Formu s rozmermi asi 20 × 20 cm alebo liatinovú panvicu vymasti trochou masla a daj ju zohriať do rúry, horúca forma vytvorí chrumkavú kôrku.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Grease a tin of about 20 × 20 cm or a cast-iron pan with a little of the butter and put it in the oven to heat; a hot tin gives a crisp crust.

steps.sk: Zvyšné maslo rozpusti a nechaj trochu vychladnúť. V mise zmiešaj polentu, múku, cukor, prášok do pečiva a soľ.
steps.en: Melt the remaining butter and let it cool a little. In a bowl mix the polenta, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.

steps.sk: V druhej miske rozšľahaj vajcia s cmarom a rozpusteným maslom. Vlej ich do suchých surovín, pridaj kukuricu a len krátko premiešaj, kým nezmizne suchá múka; hrudky nevadia.
steps.en: In another bowl whisk the eggs with the buttermilk and melted butter. Pour into the dry ingredients, add the corn and stir briefly just until no dry flour remains; lumps are fine.

steps.sk: Cesto vlej do horúcej formy, uhlaď ho a peč 20 až 25 minút, kým nie je povrch zlatý a špajľa zapichnutá do stredu nevyjde čistá.
steps.en: Pour the batter into the hot tin, smooth the top and bake for 20 to 25 minutes until golden and a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean.

steps.sk: Nechaj 10 minút vychladnúť a nakrájaj na štvorce. Podávaj vlažný s maslom a medom alebo k chili a polievkam. Zabalený vydrží 2 dni a dá sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Cool for 10 minutes and cut into squares. Serve warm with butter and honey or alongside chilli and soups. Wrapped, it keeps for 2 days and freezes well.

title.sk: Medovo-horčicové kuracie stehná s fazuľkou a zemiakmi
title.en: Honey mustard chicken thighs with green beans and potatoes

description.sk: Celá večera z jedného plechu: stehná v lepkavej medovo-horčicovej glazúre so zeleninou.
description.en: A whole dinner on one tray: thighs in a sticky honey mustard glaze with vegetables.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 210 °C. Zemiaky nakrájaj na kocky 3 cm, premiešaj ich s polovicou oleja a polovicou soli, rozlož na plech a peč 15 minút, aby dostali náskok.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Cut the potatoes into 3 cm cubes, toss with half the oil and half the salt, spread on a tray and roast for 15 minutes to give them a head start.

steps.sk: Medzitým zmiešaj med, horčicu, prelisovaný cesnak, tymian, citrónovú šťavu a zvyšný olej. Stehná osoľ zvyšnou soľou, okoreň ich a obaľ v polovici glazúry.
steps.en: Meanwhile mix the honey, mustard, crushed garlic, thyme, lemon juice and remaining oil. Season the thighs with the remaining salt and the pepper and coat them in half the glaze.

steps.sk: Zemiaky na plechu posuň k okrajom, do stredu ulož stehná a peč 20 minút.
steps.en: Push the potatoes to the edges of the tray, put the thighs in the middle and roast for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Na plech pridaj fazuľku, stehná potri zvyškom glazúry a peč ešte 12 až 15 minút, kým glazúra nie je zlatohnedá a lepkavá a šťava z mäsa pri prepichnutí nie je číra.
steps.en: Add the green beans to the tray, brush the thighs with the rest of the glaze and roast for 12 to 15 more minutes until the glaze is golden and sticky and the juices run clear when the meat is pierced.

steps.sk: Nechaj 5 minút odpočívať a podávaj priamo z plechu, výpek prelej cez zemiaky. Vydrží v chladničke 3 dni a dobre sa hodí do krabičky.
steps.en: Rest for 5 minutes and serve straight from the tray, spooning the juices over the potatoes. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days and packs well for lunches.

title.sk: Orechový koláč s javorovým sirupom
title.en: Maple walnut pie

description.sk: Krehký korpus s karamelovou plnkou z javorového sirupu a vlašských orechov, inšpirovaný pecan pie.
description.en: A crisp pastry case with a caramel filling of maple syrup and walnuts, inspired by pecan pie.

note.sk: 90 g do cesta, 30 g do plnky
note.en: 90 g for the pastry, 30 g for the filling

steps.sk: Múku zmiešaj so štipkou soli, pridaj 90 g studeného masla na kocky a rozotri ho na drobky. Pridaj 3 až 4 lyžice ľadovej vody a rýchlo spoj do cesta. Zabaľ ho a nechaj 30 minút v chladničke.
steps.en: Mix the flour with a pinch of salt, add 90 g of cold butter in cubes and rub it in to crumbs. Add 3 to 4 tablespoons of ice-cold water and quickly bring together into a dough. Wrap and chill for 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C. Cesto rozvaľkaj na kruh hrubý 3 mm a vystel ním koláčovú formu s priemerom 24 cm, okraje zahni. Dno prepichaj vidličkou a korpus peč 12 minút nasucho.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Roll the pastry into a 3 mm thick circle and line a 24 cm pie tin, folding the edges over. Prick the base with a fork and blind-bake for 12 minutes.

steps.sk: Na plnku rozpusti 30 g masla a vyšľahaj ho s javorovým sirupom, hnedým cukrom, vajcami, vanilkovým cukrom a štipkou soli. Orechy nahrubo nalámaj a rozsyp ich na predpečený korpus.
steps.en: For the filling melt 30 g of butter and whisk it with the maple syrup, brown sugar, eggs, vanilla sugar and a pinch of salt. Break the walnuts roughly and scatter them over the part-baked case.

steps.sk: Orechy zalej plnkou, zníž teplotu na 170 °C a peč 35 až 40 minút, kým plnka nie je po okrajoch stuhnutá a v strede sa pri potrasení len mierne chveje. Ak okraje tmavnú príliš rýchlo, prikry ich alobalom.
steps.en: Pour the filling over the walnuts, lower the oven to 170 °C and bake for 35 to 40 minutes until set at the edges and only slightly wobbly in the centre when shaken. If the edges darken too quickly, cover them with foil.

steps.sk: Koláč nechaj vychladnúť aspoň 2 hodiny, kým plnka úplne nestuhne, inak sa pri krájaní rozlieva. Prikrytý vydrží 4 dni v chladničke.
steps.en: Leave the pie to cool for at least 2 hours until the filling has fully set, otherwise it runs when cut. Covered, it keeps for 4 days in the fridge.
